entities.summary: Lake Saroma , also Saroma Lagoon, is a coastal lagoon in Saroma, Kitami, and Yūbetsu. It is located in Abashiri Quasi-National Park. By area, the lake is the third largest in Japan and the largest in Hokkaidō.
